description: Second held-out corpus, written from the intent definitions in SPEC.md and from how a person actually types, not from the router's matcher. The existing held-out-negatives.json was built by taking the nouns the matcher keys on and writing general-knowledge sentences around them, so it can only confirm the gate it was derived from. This corpus deliberately avoids that vocabulary: the positives are situation questions phrased without the possessive 'my' the deixis gate leans on, and the negatives are general-knowledge questions that DO contain deictic words ('should I', 'my desk', 'this'), which is where a deixis-only gate over-fires. Cases are scored, not curated to pass. `capture` records whether an image capture is the correct answer; a case with capture=false that routes to a take_* tool is an unrequested capture and fails CI outright.
